description: Land Acquisition - Thambilipitiya, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing parcels of land to be acquired for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of the lands, their boundaries, extents, and the legal process for acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
